name: CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2024
information: This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2024). ​ Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2024) during the award ceremony there. ​ This competition will take place at 5 different venues across the Southeast.
